decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Combo - Transmogrify archetype, which involves using cards like Transmogrify to turn a token creature into a game-winning bomb like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or another powerful creature. The deck also includes support cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to help set up the combo, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act to control the board. The companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, can provide additional mana acceleration and support.

The deck focuses on utilizing Amalia's life gain ability to generate mana and combo off with Aetherflux Reservoir. It includes various creature cards that can gain life or be brought back from the graveyard to create a strong board presence. Chord of Calling and Fauna Shaman help tutor for key pieces of the combo, while Collected Company provides additional creature options. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and removal with Skyclave Apparition. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently gaining life and setting up the combo to win the game.

The deck focuses on disruptive spells and hand control to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also using cards like Waste Not to generate advantage from discarding cards. The win condition of the deck is to ultimately grind the opponent out of resources with cards like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, while also using removal spells like Fatal Push to maintain board control. The deck also includes a mana base that supports the control strategy and allows for various utility lands to be utilized for additional benefits.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's hand and board through discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act, and powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil. The deck also aims to generate card advantage with cards like Mazemind Tome and Waste Not, as well as disrupt the opponent's resources with cards like Go Blank and Sheoldred's Edict. This control deck looks to grind out the opponent's resources while maintaining a strong board presence with cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and disruption to overwhelm opponents quickly. It utilizes powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to clear the way for its creatures, such as Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also includes cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to provide additional value and support for its aggressive game plan. By combining efficient threats with disruptive elements, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the game.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells, utilizing cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord, Bloodtithe Harvester, and Archfiend of the Dross to quickly close out games. The mana base is designed to enable consistent plays and provide additional utility with cards like Mutavault and Hive of the Eye Tyrant. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Duress helps control the opponent's hand, while also supporting the aggressive game plan. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain tempo to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to maximize card draw and graveyard manipulation in order to consistently bring out Arclight Phoenix and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. The deck includes cards like Sleight of Hand, Treasure Cruise, and Lightning Axe to help dig for key pieces and remove threats, while also utilizing Galvanic Iteration to create extra copies of important spells. The goal is to quickly amass a board presence with Arclight Phoenix and control the tempo of the game to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of cards that allow the player to create powerful synergies and combos to overwhelm their opponent. By utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Deduce, the player can quickly set up a board state that is difficult for the opponent to deal with. Additionally, cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and The Wandering Emperor provide additional support and value to the overall strategy. The deck also includes some control elements like Dovin's Veto and Lightning Helix to help protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's plans.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on efficiently dealing damage to the opponent while disrupting their hand with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Preacher of the Schism provide additional value by buffing creatures and creating tokens. Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper serve as aggressive threats, while removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act help clear the way for the deck's creatures. The deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent and close out games quickly before they can stabilize.

Mono Black Control focuses on disrupting opponent's game plan by utilizing a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and graveyard synergies. The deck includes cards like Thoughtseize and Go Blank to strip away key cards from the opponent's hand, while Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict take care of threats on the battlefield. Waste Not generates value by turning opponent's discards into resources. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil to control the board and generate card advantage. Overall, Mono Black Control aims to outvalue and grind down opponents with efficient removal and disruption.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of creatures and spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester with disruption spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure victory. With a strong mana base and support from cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, this deck is built to maintain pressure from the early game to the late game, making it a formidable force in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive strategies to quickly overwhelm opponents with efficient creature threats and disruption spells. The deck utilizes powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Preacher of the Schism, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act to control the board and maintain pressure. The inclusion of cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional ways to boost creatures and close out games quickly. With a mix of threats and disruption, this deck aims to win the game before opponents can stabilize.

This deck revolves around utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to control the board and search for specific creatures and enchantments in order to maintain dominance over the opponent. The inclusion of diverse cards like Rest in Peace, Dovin's Veto, and Path to the World Tree allows for effective disruption and strategy adaptation. By combining powerful creatures such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines with versatile enchantments like Chained to the Rocks and Leyline Binding, the deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through calculated plays and resource management.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced aggression and disruption, utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board while deploying threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord enhances the creature's capabilities, and Mutavault provides additional pressure. The deck also includes various utility lands to further support its game plan. Overall, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a mix of efficient creatures and disruptive spells in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures and combat tricks to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive play. The inclusion of Jegantha as a Companion provides additional flexibility and mana acceleration. The deck includes a mix of protection spells, removal, and pump spells to keep the pressure on the opponent while protecting its own creatures. By utilizing a mix of efficient creatures and combat tricks, the deck aims to win the game through fast, aggressive plays and outmaneuvering the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly get Arclight Phoenix on the battlefield by casting multiple spells in a turn. Cards like Consider, Fiery Impulse, and Lightning Axe help trigger the ability of Arclight Phoenix to return from the graveyard. Galvanic Iteration can be used to replicate powerful spells like Treasure Cruise or Temporal Trespass. Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder provide card advantage and disruption to the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Ashiok, Dream Render helps to disrupt the opponent's graveyard interactions. The deck aims to be fast and aggressive, putting pressure on the opponent early in the game.
